name: PdxInfiniteScroll
description:
Loads more data as the user scrolls to the bottom, paging a DataSource or firing
`pdx-load-more` for manual control.

members.name: threshold
members.description: Pixels from bottom to trigger load

members.name: endMessage
members.description: Message when all data loaded. Empty: the infinite-scroll.end component string, «No more data».

members.name: loadingMessage
members.description: Loading indicator text. Empty: the infinite-scroll.loading component string, «Loading...».

members.name: showEndMessage
members.description: Show end message when all data loaded

events.name: pdx-load-more
events.description: The sentinel came into view and more can be loaded: after the source's own `loadMore()`, if it has one.

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: Pixels from bottom to trigger load

attributes.name: endmessage
attributes.description: Message when all data loaded. Empty: the infinite-scroll.end component string, «No more data».

attributes.name: loadingmessage
attributes.description: Loading indicator text. Empty: the infinite-scroll.loading component string, «Loading...».

attributes.name: showendmessage
attributes.description: Show end message when all data loaded

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: sentinel
cssParts.description: The invisible line whose coming into view loads more.

cssParts.name: loading
cssParts.description: The «loading» status, with its spinner; it says something only while loading.

cssParts.name: end
cssParts.description: The «no more data» status; it says something only at the end of the source.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: The source is pending, or `loading` is set: the host is `aria-busy` too (A4).

cssStates.name: ended
cssStates.description: The source has nothing more to load.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: `disabled` is set: nothing more is loaded.
